title: 5 Reasons to Buy: Fusion™ Dentures
html:

1. Hand-poured esthetics: Hand-poured materials settle into a digital design for natural characterization and lifelike gingiva.

2. Predictable digital fit: Scans capture real anatomy to deliver a precise fit immediately.

3. Serviceable and repairable: Fully repairable acrylic allows easy relines as your patient’s mouth changes over time.

4. Faster case turnaround: Deliver full dentures in five days and flexible partials in six days.

5. Streamlined 2-Appointment Workflow: Cut seat time in half with an efficient process that keeps patients happy.

By combining hand-poured materials with digital scans, Fusion delivers natural gingival characterization without sacrificing fit or durability. Built with clinically trusted materials, these restorations are fully serviceable for simple chairside relines. Modernize your practice, save chair time, and deliver custom removables in just two appointments.

Specifications

  • Turnaround: Five days for full, six days for partials
  • Materials: Hand-poured acrylic (Full Dentures), Valplast® or Duraflex® (Partial Dentures)
  • Workflow: 2-appointment digital scan or wash impression
